slides.title: Downsizing in Laval? Run these 5 numbers first.
slides.sub: Real Vimont and Laval-des-Rapides prices, house vs condo.

photo.credit: Photo: Natthager, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: The house-to-condo gap
slides.body: In both sectors, the median condo costs about **$264K to $273K less** than the median house.

slides.title: The welcome tax comes back
slides.body: You pay it again on the condo you buy. Take it off your gap before you plan.
slides.source: Per Québec.ca 2026 rates, with Centris Q3 2026

slides.title: Condos can take longer to sell

photo.credit: Photo: MaxCote, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Vimont houses averaged **30 days** on market. Laval-des-Rapides condos: **55 days**, with about 73 for sale at a time.

slides.title: Sell first, buy first, or bridge?
slides.body: A bridge loan is temporary financing between homes, often 90 days to 12 months. Ask your mortgage broker.

slides.title: Add condo fees to the math
slides.body: Every Québec syndicate must keep a contingency fund. Ask for the budget and recent meeting minutes.
slides.source: Per CMHC, Québec condo fact sheet
